verdicts.reason: A shrinks everything, so the can and the type look small. The subtitle sits almost on top of the CTA button, and about 100px of dead space is left at the bottom. The NEW FLAVOR badge floats down at an arbitrary height that doesn't line up with the logo. B keeps the original scale and fills the portrait canvas with the logo, can, headline, subtitle and CTA stacked cleanly in that order. It also gives the subtitle proper room above the CTA. Its only minor issues are the badge sitting tight in the top-left corner and a slightly shallow margin under the CTA.
